selected_evidence.requirement: Identify eligible duplicates while preserving permission boundaries and mutable independence
selected_evidence.summary: Only the two root-owned 0644 release payloads were eligible. The identical 0600 private.dat and mutable/active.dat were excluded; the dry run proposed exactly one link.

selected_evidence.requirement: Reclaim duplicate payload storage and preserve every pathname, byte, owner, and mode
selected_evidence.summary: The cache pass linked exactly one 1.81 KiB duplicate. Five paths and all SHA-256 hashes remain; the eligible payloads share an inode with link count 2, while private.dat and mutable/active.dat retain independent inodes.

selected_evidence.requirement: A later cache pass makes no further changes
selected_evidence.summary: Dry runs before and after reboot both reported Linked: 0 files and Saved: 0 B.

selected_evidence.requirement: Keep the installed operating-system release and kernel
selected_evidence.summary: CentOS Stream 10 and kernel 6.12.0-205.el10.x86_64 were unchanged across the work and reboot.

selected_evidence.requirement: Mandatory node1 restart: healthy baseline, acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Pre-restart data assertions passed and the safe reboot was acknowledged. The boot ID changed, system state returned to running, and post-restart hashes, modes, inode relationships, path count, OS, kernel, and mount health all passed.
